Doc links — one registry, every surface

Features·seedling·implemented·JUL 23, 2026

A single typed DocLink module maps UI surfaces to kolu.dev doc pages, a set-equality test keeps it in lock-step with the website content, and the welcome card + tips grow "learn more" links — restoring the remote-hosts pointer PR

Contents

  • DOC1 — the registry: ui/DocLink.tsx
  • DOC2 — the link sweep
  • DOC3 — welcome moments: linked, actionable, state-aware
  • DOC4 — tips carry doc slugs
  • Done when

Implemented in #1959.

#1948 shipped remote hosts out of alpha but deleted the whole RemoteHostsAlphaNotice — badge, warning, and the “Learn more →” link to kolu.dev/remote-hosts/. The add-host popover is now a bare ssh input with no pointer to its docs. A survey of the client found only three kolu.dev links in the entire UIWelcomeMoments.tsx (home page + #remote anchors), kaval/KavalInfoDialog.tsx and right-panel/KavalAttachSection.tsx (both /kaval/) — each hand-rolling its own <a> with its own private URL constant., while ~a dozen surfaces that explain a documented feature link nowhere. This note is the plan of record for fixing the structure, not just the regression. One PR, implemented by a terminal agent; work items DOC1–DOC4 below are sections of that PR, not phases.

DOC1 — the registry: ui/DocLink.tsx

One module owns the slug↔URL knowledge (today it’s smeared across three files as string literals — incidental duplication with nothing keeping any copy honest):

  • export type DocSlug = "agent-detection" | "canvas" | … | "troubleshooting" — a hand-written literal union, one member per page in website/src/content/docs/*.mdx.
  • export const docUrl = (slug: DocSlug, anchor?: string) => → https://kolu.dev/${slug}/ (+ #anchor). Trailing slash matches how the existing kaval links are spelled.
  • export const DocLink: Component<{ slug; anchor?; children }> — the inline anchor (text-accent hover:underline, target="_blank", rel="noopener noreferrer"). Button-chrome sites (the KavalInfoDialog “Docs” button) keep their styling and take docUrl() for the href.

The verdict is leaf, not electricity: bounded data plus a one-tag component, no volatility hidden — it stays a client module, no @kolu/* package.

Two tests in ui/DocLink.test.ts enforce the sync the module exists for:

  1. Set equality — readdirSync the repo’s website/src/content/docs/, strip .mdx, assert the basename set equals the DocSlug union (exported as a runtime array the union derives fromconst DOC_SLUGS = [...] as const; type DocSlug = (typeof DOC_SLUGS)[number] — one source for both the type and the test.). Adding, renaming, or deleting a doc page without touching the registry is a red build in both directions — fail fast, no drift.
  2. Grep law — no kolu.dev literal anywhere in packages/client/src outside DocLink.tsx. This only passes once DOC2 migrates the three legacy sites, and it keeps the consolidation permanent: a future hand-rolled anchor cannot compile past CI.

Plus .apm/instructions/doc-links.instructions.md (applyTo: {website/src/content/docs/**,packages/client/src/ui/DocLink.tsx}), the agent-facing statement of the same invariant, sitting beside website-docs.instructions.md: touch a doc page’s existence or name → update the registry in the same change; link to docs from the UI only through DocLink/docUrl.

DOC3 — welcome moments: linked, actionable, state-aware

The current card is what welcome-revamp shipped — three static rows whose links point at the kolu.dev home page, and a “Pin it — Installed as an app ✓” row that spends a third of the card telling you about something already done. The redesign keeps one card but makes it a prioritized list:

  • Moment list, in order: Pin it · Reach it anywhere · Run agents · Add a host · Shortcuts. Done-predicates: Pin = app.isInstalled(); Reach = location.protocol === "https:"; Add a host = the host pool has more than one member (via useHostMembers); Run agents and Shortcuts are never “done”. The card renders the first three undone moments; done moments collapse into a single muted header line (“📌 Pinned ✓ · 🌐 Reachable ✓”). The selection is a pure function (pinDone, reachDone, hostsDone) → rows, unit-tested directly.
  • Rows act, not just describe — through the existing action seams, never a parallel path: the Run-agents row invokes the same action its advertised ⌘Enter keybind fires (input/actions.ts); the Shortcuts row opens the ShortcutsHelp overlay exactly as ⌘/ does. The one-click Install button stays.
  • Every moment carries its DocLink: Pin (manual steps) → install-pwa; Reach → remote-access (replacing the #remote home-page anchor, including the insecure-origin Tailscale line); Run agents → agent-detection; Add a host → remote-hosts; Shortcuts → keyboard-shortcuts. The footer “Full guide → kolu.dev” retargets to first-five-minutes, and the private GUIDE_URL constant dies.

Mobile is untouched — showsWelcome() is already false there.

DOC4 — tips carry doc slugs

Tip (in settings/tips.ts) grows an optional doc?: DocSlug; TipBanner.tsx renders a trailing “Docs →” DocLink when present. Wire the tips whose page is obvious: amb-host-map → remote-hosts, amb-pwa-install → install-pwa, the theme tips → theming, the canvas-gesture tips → canvas, amb-tile-maximize → tiles, the inspector tips → right-panel, the code-tab tips → code-tab, amb-dock-sleeping → dock, amb-export-session/amb-screenshot → power-features. Tips without a clean mapping stay linkless — no field is forced.

Done when

  • Both DOC1 tests are green — which structurally proves the sweep migrated every legacy literal and the registry matches the website page set.
  • The welcome-moment selection function has direct unit coverage for the collapse/next-tier states.
  • Evidence (per the evidence skill): screenshots of the add-host popover with its restored link, and the welcome card in at least two states (fresh vs. pinned+reachable showing the next-tier moments).
  • The changelog <Change> and any stale doc sentences ride the same PR, per website-docs.instructions.md.
